abstract: Features of hepatic and enteric tissue have been detected in serial sections of 2 out of 6 endodermal sinus tumors (EST) and embryonal carcinomas of the testis showing endodermal sinus areas. Hepatic nests, which appeared as tubules, cords and giant multinucleated cells, were PAS-positive as well as immunoreactive for alphafetoprotein (AFP) and cytokeratin (CK). Enteric tubules were found within EST areas and were characterized by their lack of cell atypism. The presence of diffuse PAS-, AFP- and CK-reactivity in cytoplasm, together with a brush border or an apical staining for CEA, were quite distinctive. EST showed a potential for both intra- and extraembryonal endodermic development and may be interpreted as a monophyletic teratoma.
abstract_ja: 精巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍(EST)6例のうち2例、および卵黄嚢領域を伴う精巣胎児性癌の連続切片で、肝組織と腸管組織の特徴が検出された。肝巣は管状、索状、巨大多核細胞として見られ、PAS陽性であるとともに、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とサイトケラチン(CK)に免疫反応性を示した。腸管様の管腔はEST領域内に認められ、細胞異型を欠くことが特徴であった。細胞質におけるびまん性のPAS、AFP、CKの反応性と、刷子縁または頂部のCEA染色は非常に特徴的であった。ESTは胚体内および胚体外の内胚葉への発生能を示し、単一起源の奇形腫として解釈できる可能性がある。
